data.title: Why Is Crypto Going Down? Bitcoin Tests $80,000 as Ethereum, XRP and Dogecoin Sink to August Lows
data.description: Crypto prices kept sliding today (Monday), with Bitcoin (BTC) at $79,979 on Binance at 08:22 UTC, about 6% below last Wednesday's high of $84,898.
